register.reg_condition: when (FEAT_EBEP is implemented or FEAT_PMUv3_SS is implemented) and FEAT_AA64 is implemented

purpose_text.para: Provides EL1 configuration options for the Performance Monitors.

field_description.para: Snapshot Enable. Controls the generation of Capture events.

field_value_description.para: Capture events are enabled and prohibited.
Capture events are enabled and allowed.

field_reset_condition.condition: the highest implemented Exception level is EL1

field_description.para: Local (Kernel) PMU Exception Enable. Enables PMU Profiling exceptions taken to the current Exception level.

field_value_description.para: PMU Profiling exceptions taken to the current Exception level are disabled.
PMU Profiling exceptions taken to the current Exception level are not affected by this field.

field_description.para: Performance Monitors Exception Enable. Controls the generation of the PMUIRQ signal and the PMU Profiling exception at EL0 and EL1.
This field is ignored by the PE when any of the following are true:

listitem.content: All of the following are true: EL3 is implemented. MDCR_EL3.PMEE != 0b01.
All of the following are true: EL2 is implemented and enabled in the current Security State. MDCR_EL2.PMEE != 0b01.

field_value_description.para: The PMUIRQ signal is asserted on a PMU overflow, and the PMU Profiling exception is disabled.
The PMUIRQ signal is deasserted, and the PMU Profiling exception is enabled.

field_reset_condition.condition: the highest implemented Exception level is EL1
